violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline (26 TAC §747.501(11))
violation_type.short_title: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have the required emergency preparedness plan.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have the required emergency preparedness plan.
The operational policies did not include the contact information to report abuse or neglect.
The operational policies does not inform parents on how to contact the local Licensing office, Texas Abuse and Neglect Website and the HHSC website.
Instructions for contacting licensing office and Texas abuse and neglect hotline were missing in the operational policies.
There is no emergency preparedness plan.
